arithmetic.B0: TPS_on/TPS_off per prompt (median over eligible paired rounds), equal family weight, geometric mean across families; on = prefetch with charged reserve at the same total target, off = current deployment at the same target
arithmetic.B1: same reduced slot count in both arms (both charge the reserve), prefetch off versus on
arithmetic.B2: shadow mode (forecast, no reads) versus the no-predictor reserve control

bootstrap.resample: prompts within family, eligible rounds within prompt

arithmetic.eligibility: both arms complete, exact output IDs and router digests match, no swap delta, nominal thermal, within budget

eligibility_rule.approval: the decode serialization rounds' timing rule, reused for the 0.2.19 release benchmark as registered
eligibility_rule.eligible: both arms complete with exact output IDs and router digests, no host swap-out delta during either arm, the engine process's own page-ins (proc_pid_rusage ri_pageins, which also counts file-backed faults) grow by at most page_in_threshold_pages during the measured request, thermal nominal afterwards
eligibility_rule.name: process-pageins-v1
eligibility_rule.page_in_threshold_status: placeholder until the W0 pre-measurement of a clean 512-output request
eligibility_rule.readiness: thermal nominal, low power off, reclaimable memory at or above the preflight, host swap-out counter unchanged over a 30 s sample (at most 600 s waiting); swap-ins are not a readiness input
